entries.base_filename: ابن باجة - رسائل جديدة - ط مدريد
entries.title: Rasāʾil jadīda li-Ibn Bājja (New Treatises of Avempace)
entries.author: Ibn Bājja (Avempace, d. 1138)
entries.notes: Andalusi Aristotelian philosopher; Ibn Rushd's predecessor. Madrid edition of newly-published treatises. Bridges Ibn Sina and Averroist tradition.

entries.title: Al-Iḥāṭa (The Comprehensive Treatise)
entries.author: Ibn Sabʿīn (d. 1271)
entries.notes: Andalusi Sufi philosopher; author of the answers to Frederick II's questions. Held a radical waḥdat al-wujūd position. Al-Iḥāṭa surveys the metaphysics of unity.

entries.base_filename: ابن قسي - خلع النعلين واقتباس النور من موضع القدمين
entries.title: Khalʿ al-Naʿlayn wa-Iqtibās al-Nūr min Mawḍiʿ al-Qadamayn (Removing the Two Sandals)
entries.display_title: خلع النعلين واقتباس النور من موضع القدمين
entries.author: Ibn Qasī (d. 1151)
entries.notes: Foundational early Andalusi Sufi text. Ibn ʿArabī wrote a commentary on it. The 'removing the sandals' refers to Moses at the burning bush — symbol of approaching divine presence.

entries.base_filename: ابن عربي - أجوبة ابن عربي على أسئلة الحكيم الترمذي
entries.title: Ajwibat Ibn ʿArabī ʿalā Asʾilat al-Ḥakīm al-Tirmidhī (Ibn ʿArabī's Answers to al-Tirmidhī's Questions)
entries.display_title: أجوبة ابن عربي على أسئلة الحكيم الترمذي
entries.author: Muḥyī al-Dīn Ibn ʿArabī (d. 1240)
entries.notes: Ibn ʿArabī's responses to 157 questions posed by the 9th-c. Sufi al-Ḥakīm al-Tirmidhī about sainthood (walāya). Central source for Akbarian doctrine of the saints.

entries.base_filename: ابن عربي - نص لم يسبق نشره حول الولاية والنبوة
entries.title: Previously Unpublished Text on Walāya and Nubuwwa
entries.display_title: نص لم يسبق نشره حول الولاية والنبوة
entries.author: Muḥyī al-Dīn Ibn ʿArabī (d. 1240)
entries.notes: Previously unpublished Ibn ʿArabī text on the relationship between sainthood and prophecy. Continues themes from the Ajwiba and the Fuṣūṣ.
